def action_indices_to_canonical_normalized(indices: jax.Array) -> jax.Array:
    """Decode bins by gathering the materialized active-decoder grids.

    Unlike spelling division/subtraction inside a larger compiled scan, this
    gather has identical float32 bits in eager, JIT, and recurrent contexts.
    """
    _require_input_dtype(indices, np.dtype(np.int32), name='action indices')
    value = jnp.asarray(indices)
    _require_last_dimension(value, len(ACTION_DIMS), name='action indices')
    _require(value.dtype == jnp.int32, 'action indices must be exact int32')
    maximum = jnp.asarray(ACTION_DIMS, dtype=jnp.int32) - jnp.int32(1)
    bounded = jnp.clip(value.astype(jnp.int32), jnp.int32(0), maximum)
    return jnp.stack(tuple((_CANONICAL_ACTION_GRIDS[head][bounded[..., head]] for head in range(len(ACTION_DIMS)))), axis=-1).astype(jnp.float32)

def previous_action_bins_from_observation(observation: jax.Array, *, action_dims: Sequence[int]=ACTION_DIMS, legal_window_limits: Sequence[int]=LEGAL_WINDOW_LIMITS) -> tuple[jax.Array, jax.Array, jax.Array, jax.Array]:
    """Recover and validate lane-local previous-action bins.

    Returns ``(bins, valid_by_head, reconstructed, absolute_error)``.  The
    inverse is the canonical categorical rounding map, and ``reconstructed``
    is its canonical float32 decode.  A coordinate is valid only if it is
    finite, inside its actuator range, and no farther than exactly two
    float32 epsilons from that reconstruction.
    """
    (_dimensions, limits) = _validated_abi(action_dims, legal_window_limits)
    _require_input_dtype(observation, np.dtype(np.float32), name='observation')
    value = jnp.asarray(observation)
    _require_last_dimension(value, OBSERVATION_DIM, name='observation')
    _require(value.dtype == jnp.float32, 'observation must be float32')
    history = value[..., ACTION_HISTORY_START:ACTION_HISTORY_STOP]
    finite = jnp.isfinite(history)
    safe_history = jnp.where(finite, jnp.clip(history, ACTION_LOW, ACTION_HIGH), jnp.zeros_like(history))
    bins = normalized_actions_to_indices(safe_history).astype(jnp.int32)
    reconstructed = action_indices_to_canonical_normalized(bins)
    absolute_error = jnp.where(finite, jnp.abs(reconstructed - history), jnp.asarray(jnp.inf, dtype=jnp.float32)).astype(jnp.float32)
    in_range = (history >= ACTION_LOW) & (history <= ACTION_HIGH)
    valid_by_head = finite & in_range & (absolute_error <= jnp.asarray(GRID_TOLERANCE, dtype=jnp.float32))
    del limits
    return (bins, valid_by_head, reconstructed, absolute_error)

def select_five_head_action(logits: Sequence[jax.Array], observation: jax.Array, reset: jax.Array, recovery_selected: jax.Array, *, action_dims: Sequence[int]=ACTION_DIMS, legal_window_limits: Sequence[int]=LEGAL_WINDOW_LIMITS) -> tuple[jax.Array, dict[str, jax.Array]]:
    """Select one categorical action under the frozen R8ZD rule.

    Reset and unselected rows use the five global modes.  A valid selected
    non-reset row instead computes each argmax *inside* its causal legal
    window; it never clips a previously computed global mode.  ``jnp.argmax``
    supplies the registered lowest-index tie break for both modes.

    Any non-finite logit invalidates the row.  On non-reset rows, any invalid
    history coordinate also invalidates the row even when recovery is not
    selected.  The returned fallback remains deterministic, but it is not an
    executable action until the host guard accepts ``execution_valid``.
    """
    (dimensions, limits_tuple) = _validated_abi(action_dims, legal_window_limits)
    _require_input_dtype(observation, np.dtype(np.float32), name='observation')
    _require_input_dtype(reset, np.dtype(np.bool_), name='reset')
    _require_input_dtype(recovery_selected, np.dtype(np.bool_), name='recovery_selected')
    lane_observation = jnp.asarray(observation)
    _require_last_dimension(lane_observation, OBSERVATION_DIM, name='observation')
    _require(lane_observation.dtype == jnp.float32, 'observation must be float32')
    leading_shape = lane_observation.shape[:-1]
    head_logits = _validated_logits(logits, leading_shape, dimensions)
    reset_value = jnp.asarray(reset)
    recovery_selected_value = jnp.asarray(recovery_selected)
    _require(reset_value.dtype == jnp.bool_, 'reset must be boolean')
    _require(recovery_selected_value.dtype == jnp.bool_, 'recovery_selected must be boolean')
    _require(reset_value.shape == leading_shape, 'reset shape must match logits rows')
    _require(recovery_selected_value.shape == leading_shape, 'recovery_selected shape must match logits rows')
    (previous_bins, history_valid_by_head, reconstructed, reconstruction_error) = previous_action_bins_from_observation(lane_observation, action_dims=dimensions, legal_window_limits=limits_tuple)
    history_all_valid = jnp.all(history_valid_by_head, axis=-1)
    dimension_array = jnp.asarray(dimensions, dtype=jnp.int32)
    limit_array = jnp.asarray(limits_tuple, dtype=jnp.int32)
    legal_lower = jnp.maximum(jnp.int32(0), previous_bins - limit_array)
    legal_upper = jnp.minimum(dimension_array - jnp.int32(1), previous_bins + limit_array)
    finite_by_head_parts: list[jax.Array] = []
    global_modes: list[jax.Array] = []
    legal_modes: list[jax.Array] = []
    finite_floor = jnp.asarray(jnp.finfo(jnp.float32).min, dtype=jnp.float32)
    for (head, (value, dimension)) in enumerate(zip(head_logits, dimensions, strict=True)):
        finite = jnp.isfinite(value)
        finite_by_head_parts.append(jnp.all(finite, axis=-1))
        safe_logits = jnp.where(finite, value, finite_floor)
        global_modes.append(jnp.argmax(safe_logits, axis=-1).astype(jnp.int32))
        bin_axis = jnp.arange(dimension, dtype=jnp.int32)
        legal = (bin_axis >= legal_lower[..., head, None]) & (bin_axis <= legal_upper[..., head, None])
        masked_logits = jnp.where(legal, safe_logits, -jnp.inf)
        legal_modes.append(jnp.argmax(masked_logits, axis=-1).astype(jnp.int32))
    logits_finite_by_head = jnp.stack(finite_by_head_parts, axis=-1)
    all_logits_finite = jnp.all(logits_finite_by_head, axis=-1)
    global_mode = jnp.stack(global_modes, axis=-1).astype(jnp.int32)
    legal_window_mode = jnp.stack(legal_modes, axis=-1).astype(jnp.int32)
    execution_valid = all_logits_finite & (reset_value | history_all_valid)
    uses_legal_window = execution_valid & ~reset_value & recovery_selected_value
    selected_mode = jnp.where(uses_legal_window[..., None], legal_window_mode, global_mode).astype(jnp.int32)
    diagnostics = {'execution_valid': execution_valid, 'previous_bins': previous_bins, 'history_valid_by_head': history_valid_by_head, 'history_all_valid': history_all_valid, 'history_reconstructed': reconstructed, 'history_reconstruction_error': reconstruction_error, 'legal_lower': legal_lower, 'legal_upper': legal_upper, 'logits_finite_by_head': logits_finite_by_head, 'all_logits_finite': all_logits_finite, 'global_mode': global_mode, 'legal_window_mode': legal_window_mode, 'selected_mode': selected_mode, 'reset': reset_value, 'recovery_selected': recovery_selected_value, 'uses_legal_window': uses_legal_window}
    return (selected_mode, diagnostics)

def semantic_actor_observation(physical_observation: jax.Array) -> tuple[jax.Array, dict[str, jax.Array]]:
    """Create the private actor view without mutating physical state or input."""
    physical = jnp.asarray(physical_observation)
    _require_shape(physical, (OBSERVATION_DIM,), name='physical observation')
    _require(physical.dtype == jnp.float32, 'physical observation must be float32')
    decoded = decode_preview_observation(physical)
    canonicalized = decoded.semantic_valid & decoded.is_legacy & ~decoded.route_preview
    canonical = _numpy_set(physical, slice(ACTION_HISTORY_START, ACTION_HISTORY_STOP, None), calibrated_trim_action_history())
    actor = jnp.where(canonicalized, canonical, physical)
    outside = jnp.concatenate((actor[:ACTION_HISTORY_START], actor[ACTION_HISTORY_STOP:]))
    physical_outside = jnp.concatenate((physical[:ACTION_HISTORY_START], physical[ACTION_HISTORY_STOP:]))
    diagnostics = {'physical_observation': physical, 'actor_observation': actor, 'physical_action_history': physical[ACTION_HISTORY_START:ACTION_HISTORY_STOP], 'actor_action_history': actor[ACTION_HISTORY_START:ACTION_HISTORY_STOP], 'semantic_valid': decoded.semantic_valid, 'is_preview': decoded.is_preview, 'is_legacy': decoded.is_legacy, 'route_preview': decoded.route_preview, 'canonicalized': canonicalized, 'non_action_history_slots_bit_exact': jnp.all(jax.lax.bitcast_convert_type(outside, jnp.uint32) == jax.lax.bitcast_convert_type(physical_outside, jnp.uint32))}
    return (actor, diagnostics)

research.projects.geometry_energy_stream.source:
def reconstruct_target_forward_from_qv(qv: jax.Array) -> jax.Array:
    """Recover the target-forward body vector from quaternion-vector error.

    The compiler/environment fixes the error quaternion to the hemisphere with
    nonnegative scalar component, so ``w`` is uniquely recoverable from its
    stored vector component.  ``maximum`` handles roundoff just outside the
    unit ball without silently normalizing the vector component itself.
    """
    qv = jnp.asarray(qv)
    _require_last_dimension(qv, 3, name='qv')
    (x, y, z) = (qv[..., index] for index in range(3))
    w = jnp.sqrt(jnp.maximum(jnp.asarray(0.0, qv.dtype), 1.0 - x * x - y * y - z * z))
    return jnp.stack((1.0 - 2.0 * (y * y + z * z), 2.0 * (x * y - w * z), 2.0 * (x * z + w * y)), axis=-1)

research.projects.geometry_energy_stream.name: decode_preview_observation
research.projects.geometry_energy_stream.source:
def decode_preview_observation(observation: jax.Array) -> PreviewObservationDecode:
    """Decode the compatibility tag and construct the private legacy view.

    The numerical dispatch threshold lies strictly inside the invalid norm
    gap.  It is intentionally reported separately from ``semantic_valid``:
    runtime code must reject an invalid row instead of treating dispatch as a
    validity decision.
    """
    observation = jnp.asarray(observation)
    _require_last_dimension(observation, OBSERVATION_DIM, name='observation')
    slots = observation[..., PREVIEW_SLOT_START:PREVIEW_SLOT_STOP]
    slot_finite = jnp.all(jnp.isfinite(slots), axis=-1)
    observation_finite = jnp.all(jnp.isfinite(observation), axis=-1)
    slot_norm = jnp.linalg.norm(slots, axis=-1)
    is_preview = slot_finite & (slot_norm <= PREVIEW_MAX_NORM)
    is_legacy = slot_finite & (slot_norm >= LEGACY_MIN_NORM)
    semantic_valid = observation_finite & (is_preview | is_legacy)
    route_preview = slot_finite & (slot_norm < DISPATCH_NORM)
    reconstructed = reconstruct_target_forward_from_qv(observation[..., 0:3])
    reconstructed_observation = _numpy_set(observation, (..., slice(PREVIEW_SLOT_START, PREVIEW_SLOT_STOP, None)), reconstructed)
    base_observation = jnp.where(route_preview[..., None], reconstructed_observation, observation)
    tau = jnp.where(route_preview[..., None], PREVIEW_TO_TWIST_SCALE * slots, jnp.zeros_like(slots))
    return PreviewObservationDecode(base_observation=base_observation, tau=tau, slot_norm=slot_norm, route_preview=route_preview, is_preview=is_preview, is_legacy=is_legacy, semantic_valid=semantic_valid)

def __call__(self, variables, carry, observation, reset):
    import jax
    import jax.numpy as jnp
    if bool(np.asarray(reset)):
        self.records = []
        self.control = 0
        self.remaining = 0
    self.parent.context_provider = self.context_provider
    old = self.parent(variables, carry, observation, reset)
    row = self.parent.records[-1]
    heads = tuple((jnp.asarray(row[f'retained792_logits_{h}']) for h in range(5)))
    x = self.make_input(self.policy.source.context_parameters, jnp.asarray(row['features'])[None], tuple((h[None] for h in heads)))
    ext = self.extension(self.policy.context_parameters['motor'], x)[0]
    delta = jnp.asarray(row['transfer_raw_delta']) + ext
    ancestor = (old[0], jnp.asarray(row['retained792_action']), old[2], heads, old[4], old[5], old[6])
    active = bool(row['active'])
    proposal = parent.parent.base.choose(old, ancestor, delta, active, observation, reset, self.select)
    scores = jnp.stack([self.value(self.policy.context_parameters['benefit'], x, old[1][None], proposal[1][None], n)[0] for n in network.DURATIONS])
    started = 0
    before = self.remaining
    if active and self.remaining == 0 and (float(jnp.max(scores)) > 0.0):
        started = network.DURATIONS[int(jnp.argmax(scores))]
        self.remaining = started
    enabled = active and self.remaining > 0
    value = proposal if enabled else old
    if enabled:
        self.remaining -= 1
    if not active:
        self.remaining = 0
    protocol.require(np.array_equal(value[0], old[0]), 'shared recurrent carry changed')
    extra = dict(preserved_eeba_action=old[1], option_proposal=proposal[1], motor_input=x[0], grouped_extension=ext, grouped_raw_delta=delta, benefit_scores=scores, option_started=np.asarray(started, np.int32), option_remaining_before=np.asarray(before, np.int32), option_remaining_after=np.asarray(self.remaining, np.int32), effective_grouped_gate=np.asarray(enabled), action=value[1])
    extra.update({f'preserved_eeba_logits_{h}': v for (h, v) in enumerate(old[3])})
    self.records.append(jax.device_get(dict(row, **extra)))
    self.control += 1
    return value

def __call__(self, variables, carry, observation, reset):
    import jax
    calls = self.fca_capture.calls
    old = super().__call__(variables, carry, observation, reset)
    fca = self.fca_capture.value
    row = self.records[-1]
    i = self.control - 1
    protocol.require(self.fca_capture.calls == calls + 1 and np.array_equal(old[0], fca[0]) and np.array_equal(fca[1], row['preserved_fca_action']), 'capture must expose the already-computed unchanged fca tuple')
    veto = i == -1
    protocol.require(not veto or eligible(row), 'forced veto requires actual inherited action difference')
    value = fca if veto else old
    row.update(jax.device_get(dict(source_grouped_action=old[1], veto_action=fca[1], forced_veto=np.asarray(veto), veto_eligible=np.asarray(eligible(row)), action=value[1], one_existing_fca_call=np.asarray(True))))
    return value

def __call__(self, variables, carry, observation, reset):
    import jax
    import jax.numpy as jnp
    if bool(np.asarray(reset)):
        self.continuation_remaining = 0
    source = super().__call__(variables, carry, observation, reset)
    row = self.records[-1]
    x = self.veto_input(jnp.asarray(row['motor_input'])[None], source[1][None], jnp.asarray(row['option_proposal'])[None])
    scores = self.continuation_scores(x)
    before = self.continuation_remaining
    allowed = available(row)
    start = self.choose_start(self.control - 1, allowed, np.asarray(scores), before)
    if start:
        self.continuation_remaining = start
    if not bool(row['active']):
        self.continuation_remaining = 0
    enabled = bool(allowed and self.continuation_remaining > 0)
    heads = tuple((jnp.asarray(row[f'retained792_logits_{k}']) for k in range(5)))
    ancestor = (source[0], jnp.asarray(row['retained792_action']), source[2], heads, source[4], source[5], source[6])
    value = previous.carrier.parent.base.choose(source, ancestor, jnp.asarray(row['grouped_raw_delta']), enabled, observation, reset, self.select)
    self.continuation_remaining = max(0, self.continuation_remaining - 1)
    protocol.require(np.array_equal(source[0], value[0]), 'one unchanged recurrent execution')
    row.update(jax.device_get(dict(source_v6_action=source[1], continuation_input=x[0], continuation_scores=scores, continuation_available=np.asarray(allowed), continuation_started=np.asarray(start, np.int32), continuation_remaining_before=np.asarray(before, np.int32), continuation_remaining_after=np.asarray(self.continuation_remaining, np.int32), effective_continuation=np.asarray(enabled), action=value[1])))
